Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.text: Sunita says she is calling to talk about painting her flat.
Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.quote: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.text: Ramesh asks which flat it is and how big it is.
Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.quote: Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.text: Sunita says the flat is a 2BHK in Sector 62 Noida and the job is to paint two bedrooms, the hall, the kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings.
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62 Noida; paint two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.quote: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.text: The worker asks whether the job is only interior work or also balcony and exterior work.
Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.quote: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the job is only indoor work, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.value: only inside; two coats; putty where needed; Asian Paints Royale
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.text: Ramesh accepts Sunita's described painting job: the whole 2BHK from inside, with two coats, putty, and Royale paint.
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.value: whole 2BHK from inside, two coats, putty, Royale paint
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.quote: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.text: Sunita accepts the agreed interior painting job for the 2BHK flat in Sector 62 Noida, covering two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings.
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62 Noida; paint two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.quote: Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna loge?

Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.text: The worker says the total price is 45,000 rupees for material and labour together.
Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.quote: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.text: Sunita proposes reducing the total price to 40,000 rupees.
45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.quote: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.text: The worker says the price is changed to 42,000 rupees and cannot be lower.
Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.quote: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita says Ramesh will provide the material.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh says the material will all be his.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh asks for some advance before starting the work.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Kitna advance?.text: The hirer asks how much advance the worker wants.

15 hazaar de dijiye advance..text: Worker Ramesh asks for 15,000 rupees as advance.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita proposes reducing the advance to 10,000 rupees and paying it tomorrow by UPI.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Ramesh accepts the advance as 10,000 rupees.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Ramesh says the advance should be sent tomorrow.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.text: Sunita asks when the rest of the money should be paid.
Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.quote: Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: The worker says he will work out the start date later and asks the hirer when to begin the work.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..text: Sunita accepts start Monday, 23 November 2026 for the work.
Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..quote: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: Worker accepts the agreed start date as Monday, 2026-11-23, and says the job will finish by 2026-11-30.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: The hirer asks whether the work is definitely finished by the 30th.

Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.text: Ramesh accepts that the work will finish by 30 November.
Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.quote: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.text: The hirer asks Gawah whether everything has been noted down.
Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.quote: Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says the total becomes 43,000 rupees.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says 10,000 rupees will be taken as advance tomorrow.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.text: The hirer says the furniture must be covered while working and cleaning is the worker's responsibility.
Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.quote: Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will cover everything and leave only after cleaning.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will clean up before leaving if the job is finished.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita says she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon. Ab rakhti hoon.

Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.text: The worker says he will come on Monday at 9 a.m.
Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.quote: Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9 baje aa jaunga.

Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.text: The hirer says they will meet on Monday.
Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.quote: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.
